notes.note: #0.183-0.195 are 13 leader variants; 0359.bla checks ids 14,15,11,12,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10 = Mebius, Zero, Ultraman, Seven, Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O Sword Form, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. So #0.186 = Seven (formal "we"), #0.187 = Rider 1, #0.189 = Momotaros, #0.195 = 00 ("eradicate"). Identical Japanese (#0.188, #0.190-0.194) given identical English. "power" in quotes answers Giant Yapool (story_066 #0.182): Regis holds even the heroes' lost "power".
Glossary label is "Bemstar (Modified)"; narration uses "Modified Bemstar". Format follows earlier corpse lines ("Seamons's corpse lies here.").

Leader variants by content and 0401.bla check order: #0.1-0.4 and #0.6-0.9 are the four Ultras (Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman); Ankh #0.5 reacts between. #0.19-0.27 are the nine non-Ultras (OOO, W, Momotaros #0.21, Black RX, Rider 1, 00, Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu), voiced by register. Exact order of the non-Ultra block not verified.
Ankh's pun: Land of Light vs Land of Ice.

Two branches. Ultra-led party: #0.1-0.15 (Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman recognise Belial; Mebius polite at #0.4/#0.9). Other leaders: #0.22-0.37, order Nu, Zeta, OOO, W, Momotaros (#0.28), Black RX (#0.29), Rider 1 (#0.30), Wing Zero, 00 per 0403.bla. #0.3 "kisama" read as Zero.
"Reborns brat" = Ribbons (Reborns Gundam). Same Japanese at #0.36, same English. #0.15 and #0.37 differ only by one small kana; kept identical.
One sentence split across #0.33/#0.34; English cut at the same point.
#0.45-0.48 are the four Ultras; #0.46 Mebius calls him Taro-niisan = "Brother Taro" (matches "Brother Seven" in story_062).
#0.55-0.59 (continuing into story_068 #0.60-0.62): groan + silence pairs per leader after the Giga Battlenizer attack.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader variants assigned from Pt_Chara_Check order in 0359/0401/0403.bla plus register; 0401 non-Ultra block order unverified. Not in glossary: Ultra Sign, Plasma Spark, Plasma Spark Tower, Monster Graveyard, Belial Army, Giga Battlenizer.
